name: Skewer (x4)

boost.name: Power Attack
effect: HIT: +1 Power, gain Advantage and add this to your Gauge.
HIT: Choose one: Push 1, Pull 1, or draw 1.

name: Tri-Furket

boost.name: The Darkness
effect: The opponent adds 3 cards from their hand to their Gauge. You add 3 cards from your hand to your Gauge. (If a player has fewer than 3 cards, they add as many as possible.)
BEFORE: If you were hit, +0-2 Range.
HIT: Add the bottom card from your discard to your Gauge or hand.

name: Revenant Pillar

boost.name: Charged Attack
effect: When you Advance or Retreat, add this to your Gauge.
HIT: Choose two: Push 1, Pull 1, draw 1, the opponent discards a card at random, or gain Advantage (you may not choose the same option twice).

name: Interference

boost.name: The Light
effect: You and the opponent both draw 3. Take another action.
HIT: Push X. X is the opponent's Speed.

name: Condensity Gloom
effect: When you set this, you may place it face-up on a space. Calculate Range from that space.
AFTER: If this attacks' space is unoccupied, you may Advance or Retreat to that space.

name: In The Darkness

boost.name: Masquerade
effect: The Power and Speed of your attack are swapped (this includes printed values, bonuses, and penalties).
HIT: Push or Pull 2, draw 3, and gain Advantage.

name: Impalement

boost.name: Paradox
effect: -1 Power. The Range of your attack is inverted (your attack hits all spaces not in its Range instead).
HIT: For each Gauge you spend to pay this attack's Gauge cost, if that card's Range includes your Range to the opponent, +2 Power.
